name: Hausu

claims.claim: Restaurant and hi-fi bar at Peckham Rye station
Official site kitchen hours Tue-Fri 18-22, Sat 12-22, Sun-Mon closed; Maps appears to cover cafe hours
Sample menu lists scallop/prawn toast 9 and rice ice cream 6; discretionary 12.5% service. Sample status means not guaranteed current menu.
2026-07-06 independent review found cooking uneven; praised rice ice cream, preferred quieter foyer
